appraisal_events.evidence: quand elle demandait à ses parents s'il y avait quelqu'un à dîner, on lui répondait... le nom de ce convive d'or... Bergotte; ... il cheminait à côté d'elle, inconnu et glorieux, comme les dieux qui descendaient au milieu des mortels
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator elevates Mlle Swann in his imagination because her ordinary, unremarked intimacy with Bergotte, whom he reveres, marks her as belonging to a rarefied and privileged world far above himself.

status_effects.explanation: Gilberte is markedly elevated in the narrator's eyes: her casual, unimpressed proximity to the glorious Bergotte makes her seem a being of rare condition, filling him with desire and despair at his own comparative crudeness.
